A new chapter for the Bengali cultural community in America begins in Dallas! 🎭✨

Join us for The SazOo Show—an intimate, one-man showcase starring Sazu Khadem. Expect an unforgettable evening blending sharp satire, dynamic acting, heartfelt conversation, and non-stop fun.

📍 Venue: Bath House Cultural Center, White Rock Lake, Dallas, TX (Intimate 84-seat amphitheater for up-close interaction!)

📅 Date: December 11, 2026

🎬 Show Produced by: Multi-award-winning content producer Noman Robin

🎟️ Event Produced by: Shah Zulfiqar

Seats are strictly limited to 84—get ready for 10x the fun!

Event presented by: Dallas Bangla Group
